instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: MVNO (Mobile Virtual Network Operator) reselling mobile voice and data plans targeting the youth and digital-native segment. Ember acquired 80,000 active subscribers through aggressive digital channels focusing on high churn mitigation. The organization has significant capital, talent depth, and existing technology infrastructure, but internal processes are designed for stability and risk management rather than speed. Innovation initiatives must navigate procurement, legal, compliance, and IT security review before receiving green-light.
answers.pastInitiatives: We launched a digital customer onboarding flow last quarter that reduced average onboarding time from 12 days to 5 days. This initiative involved cross-functional work between product, compliance, and customer success teams. Early NPS scores for new customers onboarded through this flow are 22 points higher than the legacy process.
answers.strategicGoals: Growth is our existential mandate. We are losing market share to faster-moving competitors and need to reignite our growth trajectory. We are willing to make significant strategic bets, potentially including M&A or new product lines, provided they have a credible path to meaningful revenue contribution within 18 months.
answers.additionalContext: Preparing for Series A in the next 9 months. We need to articulate a clear, credible innovation strategy that differentiates us from competitors in the eyes of VCs.
answers.teamSize: Innovation is decentralized across business units, each with its own innovation lead and dedicated resources, coordinated by a group-level Chief Innovation Officer. The total innovation workforce is approximately 100 people across the organization. A group innovation fund of €5M annually is allocated competitively — business units pitch for funding against clear innovation KPIs including revenue from new products and process efficiency gains.

opportunities.title: Launch specialized B2B IoT connectivity services
opportunities.rationale: Moving beyond consumer plans into enterprise-grade solutions for industrial IoT (IIoT) presents a high-growth adjacent market. This bold move leverages Ember's existing network access and data infrastructure, potentially creating higher ARPU customers with lower churn risk.

first_actions: Conduct feasibility study on current network peering capabilities for enterprise IoT devices.
Pilot a low-cost LTE/5G module integration partnership.
Identify and secure first target industrial vertical (e.g., agriculture or logistics).
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 5 paying B2B enterprise contracts within the first 6 months.
milestones: Q3: Feasibility study complete and partnership signed.
Q4: Successful launch of pilot program with initial revenue generation.

opportunities.title: AI-driven personalized plan optimization engine
opportunities.rationale: Ember can leverage its high digital maturity (level 4) to implement a sophisticated AI tool that analyzes user data and proactively suggests customized voice/data plans. This is an incremental improvement addressing customer retention and upselling opportunities.

first_actions: Select and integrate third-party personalization API solution.
Develop internal analytics framework to model usage patterns.
Run A/B test the recommendation engine on a segment of high-value customers.
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase Average Revenue Per User (ARPU) by 5% within 9 months.
milestones: Q3: MVP development complete and internal testing passed.
Q4: Full rollout to the digital customer base.

opportunities.title: Enhanced supply chain automation for rapid plan provisioning
opportunities.rationale: Given the high competitive pressure, streamlining the backend process to allow faster deployment of new plans or features is critical. This focuses on operational efficiency rather than radical product change.

first_actions: Audit current legacy systems for bottlenecks in plan activation.
Invest in minor API upgrades to automate compliance checks.
Train customer success teams on the new automated provisioning dashboard.
resources_needed: €150k for system integration and automation tooling
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce average plan deployment time by an additional 48 hours.
milestones: Q2: System mapping and process redesign complete.
Q4: Full operational launch with measurable efficiency gains.

next_steps.action: Form a dedicated cross-functional task force to define the initial scope and budget for the B2B IoT radical initiative.
Conduct an internal talent gap analysis focused specifically on skills needed for enterprise solutions (e.g., industrial software architecture), addressing the 'talent' barrier.
Finalize the Series A narrative and align all innovation KPIs directly with defensible competitive advantages for VC presentation.

key_weaknesses: Siloed internal processes that impede organizational velocity, leading to lengthy compliance and procurement reviews.
Limited specialized talent pool outside core mobile/digital skills required for advanced enterprise solution development.
Conservative risk appetite potentially limiting the organization's ability to pursue high-growth radical ideas effectively.
